questions.q: What is the primary objective of this phase?
questions.a: To process pilot outreach outcomes, update suppression lists, and draft follow-up tasks.

questions.q: Are follow-up emails allowed to be sent automatically in this milestone?
questions.a: No. All automatic follow-up dispatches are strictly disabled.

questions.q: How must positive replies from the pilot be handled?
questions.a: They must generate follow-up drafts and place them in the owner approval queue.

questions.q: How must opt-outs and bounces be processed?
questions.a: They must be automatically added to the active suppression updates plan.

questions.q: What is the threshold rate for opt-outs that triggers a loop pause?
questions.a: An opt-out rate greater than 20% triggers a safety pause.

questions.q: What is the threshold rate for bounces that triggers a loop pause?
questions.a: A bounce rate greater than 10% triggers a safety pause.

questions.q: Are CRM mutations or writes permitted in this phase?
questions.a: No. CRM writes are strictly disabled.

questions.q: Are raw email addresses or tokens permitted in the committed logs?
questions.a: No. They must be completely redacted before saving to git-tracked files.
